rows3=rows+[icmp('c',N1+'3',probe='0/i3')]
job=campaign(rows3,
             [request('r1'),request('r2',target=N1+'2'),request('r3',target=N1+'3')],
             [offer('A',capacity=1,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3')),
              offer('B',capacity=1,cost=2,requests=('r1','r2')),
              offer('C',capacity=1,cost=9,requests=('r1',))],rq=9,og=9)
out=run(job)
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('chain',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(3,12))

# identical offers merge; their combined capacity is distributed
job=campaign(rows3,
             [request('r1'),request('r2',target=N1+'2'),request('r3',target=N1+'3')],
             [offer('A',capacity=1,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3')),
              offer('B',capacity=1,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3')),
              offer('C',capacity=1,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3'))],rq=9,og=9)
out=run(job)
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('merged offers',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(3,3))
check('merged split',sorted(a['offer'] for a in out['plan']['assignments']),
      ['A','B','C'])
# an offer quota chain caps the total even across merged offers
job=campaign(rows3,
             [request('r1'),request('r2',target=N1+'2'),request('r3',target=N1+'3')],
             [offer('A',capacity=3,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3')),
              offer('B',capacity=3,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3'))],
             rq=9,og=9)
job['offer_quotas']=[{'id':'root','parent':None,'capacity':2},
                     {'id':'o','parent':'root','capacity':9}]
out=run(job)
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('offer chain',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(2,2))
